note.question: How should one bid in first-price auctions when a bidder knows their own value but not how others will bid?
note.overview: The paper proposes how to bid in first-price auctions when a bidder knows the own value but not how others will bid. To do this, we introduce a methodology to show how to make choices in strategic settings without assuming common knowledge or equilibrium behavior. Accordingly, we first eliminate environments that are believed not to occur and then find a robust rule that performs well in the remaining environments.
